purpose: Blind second reading of national legal-status rows for methamphetamine. Report what each official text prints.

UK_MDA_SCH2.ask: Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, Schedule 2: in which Part (Class A, B or C) is methylamphetamine (methamphetamine) listed, and in which paragraph and sub-paragraph; the exact printed word; any annotation saying when and by which order the word was inserted; the date of the revised version shown.

UK_MDR_SCH2.ask: Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001, Schedule 2: is methylamphetamine (methamphetamine) listed, under which paragraph, exact printed word; the date of the revised version shown.

US_CFR_1308_12.ask: 21 CFR 1308.12 (Schedule II): the paragraph that lists methamphetamine, its exact wording, and its Controlled Substances Code Number; the "up to date as of" date of the eCFR page.

CA_CDSA_SCH1.ask: Controlled Drugs and Substances Act, Schedule I: the item number and exact wording of the methamphetamine entry; the "current to" and "last amended" dates of the page.
